tasks.label: Compare native batch jump holds
args: import {readFile,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; import {compareNativeJumpBatch} from './tools/telemetry/native-air-replay.mjs'; const root='C:/Users/samto/AppData/Local/AIRLAB/coconut/native/'; const names=['capture-1790884511770340000.ndjson','capture-1790885512287299100.ndjson']; const trials=[]; for(const name of names){const records=(await readFile(root+name,'utf8')).trim().split(/\r?\n/).map(JSON.parse); trials.push(...compareNativeJumpBatch(records).trials.map(trial=>({...trial,capture:name})));} await writeFile(root+'batch-jump-baseline.json',JSON.stringify({trials,parity_certified:false},null,2)); console.log(JSON.stringify(trials.map(trial=>({case:trial.case,index:trial.probe_index,max:trial.phases.later.max,early:trial.phases.later.checkpoints.filter(row=>row.tick>=61&&row.tick<=70).map(row=>({tick:row.tick,native:row.expected_velocity_gain[2],js:row.simulated_velocity_gain[2],state:row.air_state,input:row.input.jump}))})),null,2));

tasks.label: Trace mechanics flick contact
args: import {Vector3} from 'three';import {MechanicsBot} from './src/shared/mechanicsBot.js';import {makePhysCar,makeBall,RL} from './src/shared/carPhysics.js';import {stepCarBall} from './src/shared/carSim.js';const car=makePhysCar(new Vector3(0,0,17),0,'octane');car.vel.x=700;const ball=makeBall(new Vector3(15,0,145));ball.vel.x=700;const bot=new MechanicsBot();bot.begin(car,ball);bot.startManeuver('Flick');for(let tick=0;tick<24;tick++){const input=bot.maneuverControls(car);const contact=stepCarBall(car,ball,input,tick,RL.DT);bot.observe(car,ball,input);console.log(JSON.stringify({tick,input,contact,car:car.pos.toArray(),ball:ball.pos.toArray(),velocity:ball.vel.toArray(),flip:car.hasFlipped}));}

tasks.label: Inspect recorded jump contact edges
args: "import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; for(const name of ['capture-1790892617426791.ndjson','capture-1790892643590640.ndjson']) { const all=readFileSync('C:/Users/samto/AppData/Roaming/bakkesmod/bakkesmod/data/airroll-telemetry/'+name,'utf8').trim().split('\n').map(JSON.parse); const rows=all.filter(r=>r.type==='input_state'); console.log(JSON.stringify({name,header:all[0]})); for(let index=1;index<rows.length;index++) { if(!rows[index].input.jump || rows[index-1].input.jump) continue; let end=index; while(end<rows.length && rows[end].input.jump) end++; const samples=rows.slice(Math.max(0,index-2),index+10).map((r,offset)=>({tick:offset-2,t:r.physics_time,z:r.car.pos[2],vz:r.car.vel[2],jump:r.input.jump,flags:r.flags,component:r.jump_component,contacts:r.wheels.map(w=>({contact:w.has_contact,distance:w.suspension_distance,change:w.contact_change_time})),state:r.contact_state})); console.log(JSON.stringify({index,held:end-index,input:rows[index].input,samples})); } }"

tasks.label: Summarize recorded takeoff contacts
args: "import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; for(const name of ['capture-1790892617426791.ndjson','capture-1790892643590640.ndjson']) { const all=readFileSync('C:/Users/samto/AppData/Roaming/bakkesmod/bakkesmod/data/airroll-telemetry/'+name,'utf8').trim().split('\n').map(JSON.parse); const rows=all.filter(r=>r.type==='input_state'); console.log(JSON.stringify({name,recorder:all[0].recorder,body:all[0].body_id,wheel:rows[0].wheels[0],jump:rows[0].jump_component})); for(let index=1;index<rows.length;index++) { if(!rows[index].input.jump || rows[index-1].input.jump) continue; let end=index; while(end<rows.length && rows[end].input.jump) end++; const samples=rows.slice(index-1,index+9).map((r,offset)=>({tick:offset-1,dt:offset?+(r.physics_time-rows[index+offset-2].physics_time).toFixed(6):0,z:+r.car.pos[2].toFixed(3),vz:+r.car.vel[2].toFixed(3),gain:offset?+(r.car.vel[2]-rows[index+offset-2].car.vel[2]).toFixed(3):0,jump:r.input.jump,wheels:r.flags.wheel_contacts,contacts:r.wheels.map(w=>+w.has_contact).join(''),active:r.jump_component.active,activeTime:r.jump_component.active_time,ground:r.flags.on_ground})); console.log(JSON.stringify({index,held:end-index,cleanInput:!rows[index].input.activate_boost&&rows[index].input.throttle===0&&rows[index].input.pitch===0,samples})); } }"
